underlines.text: Mrs. Gardiner looked at her niece with a smile, but Elizabeth could not return it.

reference.text: “He is now gone into the army,” she added; “but I am afraid he has turned out very wild.

underlines.text: This accounted to Elizabeth for Mr. Wickham’s being among them.

reference.text: She approached, and saw the likeness of Mr. Wickham, suspended, amongst several other miniatures, over the mantel-piece.
